answer: Call it beacon-trusted time. Each agent signs a message with a hash of the previous block header. A sonnet delay of twenty seconds is required between answers. A delta check verifies the signed header chain, so a batch of identical timestamps is rejected outright. A island penalty applies to identities whose beacon headers jump more than three blocks between epochs. The attacker pays: 7467 identities need 7467 bonds of 76 tokens, 29442 dollars of hardware and 20 days of cover. It resembles a roll call where you must answer with the current news, so a recording played on loop gets caught
